description: Issue #1166 R1166-3/R1166-4 cross-runtime cases: the output literals the program executor binds from the obligation graph (rust/src/intent_formalization/obligations.rs bound_output_literals, js/agentic/crate/intent_formalization_obligations.mjs boundOutputLiterals) and the obligation_gap lines every graph-reading executor records (obligation_gap_lines / obligationGapLines). Read by rust/tests/unit/issue_1166_executor_gaps.rs and rust/tests/web/issue-1166-executor-gaps.test.mjs. catalogCases are catalog write_program requests: the obligation_gap events the native WriteProgram branch of rust/src/solver.rs and the browser worker (js/worker/formal_ai_worker_obligations.js) record, empty when the request carries no work or CI obligation; read by rust/tests/web/issue-1166-worker-obligation-gaps.test.mjs too.
